Answer the questions based on the information given below.

Sixteen different flats are in a four-floor building, whose bottommost floor is numbered as 1 and the topmost floor is numbered as 4. There are four types of flats on each floor (Flat W, Flat X, Flat Y, and Flat Z) such that flat W is in west of flat X, which is in west of flat Y, which is in west of Flat Z. Flat W of floor 1 is immediately below the flat W of floor 2, which is immediately below of flat W of floor 3 and so on, similarly, for flat X, flat Y and flat Z. All flats are of different area (in metre squares) (45, 50, 55, 60). At most four flats have the same area.

Note: Area of different flats on the same floor must be different. Ex- if area of flat W of 4th floor is (n) metre sq. then area of flat X, flat Y and flat Z on the 4th floor cannot be same as area as flat W.

The difference between area of flat W and flat X of the 2nd floor is 15 metre sq. The area of flat Z of 4th floor is more than the area of flat W of 4th floor. The sum of area of flat W of all the floors is 195 metre sq. The sum area of flat Z of all the floors is 225 metre sq. The sum of area of flat X and flat Z of the 3rd floor is less than 105 metre sq. Flat W of 1st floor and flat X of 3rd floor have same area.The difference between area of flat W and flat X, of the 1st floor is 5 metre sq.The sum of area of the 1st and the 4th floor of Flat Y is 110metre sq. Flat Z of 1st floor and flat X of 4th floor are of same area. The sum of area of flat X of all the floors is 210 metre sq.

The area of flat W of 4th floor is equal to the area of ____ of _____.

In making decisions about important questions, it is desirable to be able to distinguish between strong arguments and weak arguments in so far as they relate to the question. Strong arguments are those which are both important and directly related to the question. Weak arguments are those which are of minor importance and also may not be directly related to the question or may be related to a trivial aspect of the question.

 

Statement:
My son really doesn't want to wear boy clothes. He prefers to wear girl clothes. The fashion world has divided children into pink and blue. Which of the following, if true, would weaken the argument?
options: There is a growing demand for different clothing for babies and toddlers too.
People are differentiated on the idea that you have very masculine and very feminine things.
There is a whole community out there of parents and kids who are struggling with pink and blue.
The preference for neutral clothing is unstirred irrespective of gender, age and category.
I'm really keen on the gender binary and the gender roles.
questions.explanation:
The author argues that the fashion industry has divided children into two groups- one that likes to wear blue clothes and the other one that likes to wear pink clothes. Option (d) weakens this argument by stating that there is no such division of children based on certain colour preferences; instead, they still prefer neutral clothing. If option (d) is true, it cannot be deduced that fashion world has divided children into blue and pink. Option (a) is a neutral statement; it doesn't specifically talk about gender and gender clothing, (b) and (c) strongly support the argument of the author while option (e) is statement that might be representing one of the many ideologies of the author and doesn't either strengthen or weaken the given argument.

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question: Which of the following layers in the WAN layer prepares data for transmission across the network?
questions.explanation:
Layer 6 – Presentation layer

The presentation layer prepares data for transmission across the network. For example, it adds some encryption so that cybercriminals watching your WAN can't hack your sensitive meeting data.

Layer 5 – Session layer

The session layer manages the connections or sessions between local and remote applications. It can open, close, or terminate the connection between two devices. For example, your booking system is located on a web server in the central office, and you are working from home. The session layer opens a connection between your computer and the web server after authentication. This connection is a logical connection, not an actual physical connection.

Layer 4 – Transport layer

The transport layer defines the functions and procedures for data transmission. It classifies and dispatches the data for transfer. It may also package the data into data packets. For example, when you visit the booking site, the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) manages communication by sorting it into request and response packets.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a Graphical User Interface (GUI)?
options: It requires typing commands to perform tasks
It presents information and options through graphical icons and menus

It is only used on mobile devices

A GUI presents information and options through graphical icons and menus, making it easier for users to interact with the computer. A Graphical User Interface (GUI) is a type of user interface that allows users to interact with electronic devices using graphical icons and visual indicators, rather than text-based commands. Some common characteristics of a GUI include:

  • A GUI typically uses graphics, icons, and other visual elements to represent applications, files, folders, and other system resources.

  • Instead of typing commands, a user can interact with a GUI by pointing and clicking on graphical elements using a mouse or other pointing device.

  • GUIs often use menus and toolbars to provide quick access to frequently used commands and functions.

  • GUI may display dialog boxes to prompt the user for input or to provide feedback on the status of an operation.

  • Many GUIs support drag-and-drop functionality, allowing users to move files, icons, and other graphical elements by clicking and dragging them to different locations.

  • A GUI can allow users to work on multiple tasks at once, by opening multiple windows or tabs.

  • A GUI can provide graphical feedback to users, such as progress bars, animation, and visual effects, to indicate the status of an operation or to provide feedback on user interactions

questions.question: What is the syntax for the Time function in MS Excel?

  • Minute Required. A number from 0 to 32767 representing the minute. Any value greater than 59 will be converted to hours and minutes. For example, TIME(0,750,0) = TIME(12,30,0) = .520833 or 12:30 PM.

  • Second Required. A number from 0 to 32767 representing the second. Any value greater than 59 will be converted to hours, minutes, and seconds. For example, TIME(0,0,2000) = TIME(0,33,22) = .023148 or 12:33:20 AM

questions.question: After the GST Council’s latest revision in September 2025, how many main GST tax slabs exist?

Directions: In the question given below, a sentence is divided into five parts. There is/are error(s) in one or more parts of the sentence. Find out the part(s) with error(s) and choose the option accordingly.

The American Academy of Pediatrics recently(A)/ issued new guidelines for treating(B)/ more than 14 millions children(C)/ and adolescents with obesity (D)/in United States(E).
questions.explanation:
• The error lies in part (C) and part (E) of the sentence.
  • Certain quantity words like million, thousand, hundred, dozen, etc., remain singular when used after a number.
  • Examples: He donated ten thousand rupees to charity.
  • Therefore, the correct phrase would be more than 14 million children.
  •  In part (E), according to the rule, the phrase "the United States" always requires the definite article “the”.
  • Example: She was born in India, but now lives in the United Kingdom.
  • Corrected Sentence:
  • The American Academy of Pediatrics recently issued new guidelines for treating more than 14 million children and adolescents with obesity in the United States.

Hence, option B is the correct choice.

questions.question: The sentence at (A) may be erroneous grammatically or contextually. Identify the error in the sentence and choose the respective option. If there is no error, choose option (E).

II. All this calls for reforms, both, attitudinal and behavioural, and since they are largely interdependent, it is difficult to prioritise them.

(a)Add to this the set of challenges…….

(b)After removing the set of challenges…….

(c)Since the set of challenges………
questions.explanation:
"Add to this" is a phrase used to introduce additional factors or considerations. In this context, it effectively connects the two sentences by indicating that the challenges emanating from changing social conditions add to the crisis mentioned in the first sentence. It maintains the logical flow of the information. "After removing" introduces a temporal sequence, suggesting an action taken after the removal of challenges. This doesn't fit the context of introducing additional challenges or compounding the crisis. "Since" is a conjunction that typically introduces a reason or cause. In this context, it doesn't convey the sense of adding or compounding challenges but rather provides a causal relationship.

Therefore, only (a) starter can be used to form a single sentence from the two sentences given below, implying the same meaning as expressed in the statement sentences. However, it is not possible to construct a contextual sentence using the second and third starters.

Hence, the correct answer is option A.

The sentence thus formed is:

(a)Add to this the set of challenges emanating from the changing social conditions in our society, and the crisis is compounded. All this calls for reforms, both, attitudinal and behavioural, and since they are largely interdependent, it is difficult to prioritise them.

questions.question:
Directions: Select the phrase/connector (it must be at the start) from the given three options which can be used to form a single sentence from the two sentences given below, implying the same meaning as expressed in the statement sentences.

I. There could be some weight loss and reduction in Body Mass Index in the short term.

II. as the artificial sweeteners bring down the calories consumed, but in the long run they have been linked to weight gain.

(i) However

(ii) Because

(iii) While
questions.explanation:
"However" is a conjunctive adverb that indicates a contrast or contradiction. In this context, it introduces the idea that, despite the short-term benefits of weight loss and reduced BMI, there is a long-term drawback linked to weight gain.

"While" is a conjunction that introduces a contrast or concession. Similar to "however," it contrasts the short-term benefits with the long-term drawbacks, maintaining a logical connection between the sentences. "Nevertheless" is a conjunctive adverb that signals a contrast or concession, but it is redundant to use both "nevertheless" and "but" in the same sentence.

"Because" shows cause/reason and cannot be used at the start to contrast two opposite ideas like short-term weight loss vs. long-term weight gain. It would make the sentence illogical or grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, both (i) and (iii) starters can be used to form a single sentence from the two sentences given below, implying the same meaning as expressed in the statement sentences. However, it is not possible to construct a contextual sentence using the second starter.

Hence, the correct answer is option C.

The sentences thus formed are:

(i)However there could be some weight-loss and reduction in Body Mass Index in the short term as the artificial sweeteners bring down the calories consumed, but in the long run they have been linked to weight gain.

(iii)While there could be some weight-loss and reduction in Body Mass Index in the short term as the artificial sweeteners bring down the calories consumed, but in the long run they have been linked to weight gain.

\(= SI - CI \Rightarrow 4000 - 1010 \Rightarrow \text{Rs.}2990\)

\(A = P \times \left\lbrack 1 + \frac{r}{100} \right\rbrack^{t}\)

\(27040 = P \times \left\lbrack 1 + \frac{4}{100} \right\rbrack^{2}\)

\(P = \frac{27040\  \times 100 \times \ 100}{104\  \times \ 104}\)

The speed of a boat in still water is ‘x’ km/hr, and speed of the stream is 8 km/hr. If the speed of the boat in still water had been 4 km/hr more, then the total time taken by the boat to cover 120 km downstream and the same distance upstream would have been 20 hours. I. (x – 2.5) hours

II. (0.5x + 2) hours

III. (1.5x – 12) hours
questions.explanation:
According to the question,

\(\frac{120}{x\  + \ 4\  + \ 8}\) + \(\frac{120}{x\  + \ 4\  - \ 8}\) = 20

Or, 6(x – 4) + 6(x + 12) = (x + 12)(x – 4)

Or, 6x – 24 + 6x + 72 = x2 + 12x – 4x – 48

Or, x2 – 4x – 96 = 0

Or, x2 – 12x + 8x – 96 = 0

Or, x(x – 12) + 8(x – 12) = 0

Or, (x – 12)(x + 8) = 0

x = 12, -8

Since, the speed of boat cannot be negative

Therefore, x = 12

Time taken by boat to cover 120 km in downstream with original speed = \(\frac{120}{x\  + \ 8}\) = \(\frac{120}{20}\) = 6 hours

For I:

Time taken by boat to cover 120 km in downstream with original speed = (x – 2.5) = (12 – 2.5) = 9.5 hours

Therefore, I cannot be the answer.

Time taken by boat to cover 120 km in downstream with original speed = (0.5x + 2) = (6 + 2) = 8 hours

Therefore, II cannot be the answer.

For III:

Time taken by boat to cover 120 km in downstream with original speed = (1.5x – 12) = (18 – 12) = 6 hours

Therefore, III can be the answer.

Hence, the correct option is A.
